title: Which Lesson Does the Failure Teach?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Match seven real failures of technology-first school programs to the lesson each one teaches.

educational.topic: Which Lesson Does the Failure Teach?
learningObjectives: The learner will classify seven real failures as teaching one of seven lessons, correctly matching at least six of seven on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The seven cases and their lessons, from the section "When Technology Came First" in Chapter 23.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classify one item at a time with immediate feedback; first-attempt scoring
commonMisconceptions: All the failures show the same mistake.
Technology failures are caused by weak technology.
A data failure is a security failure only.
assessmentOpportunities: A district committed about $6 million to an AI chatbot startup that collapsed. Which lesson?
Were these failures caused by weak technology?
Is a data breach only a security failure?

controls.name: Category buttons
controls.description: Choose the lesson for the current failure.

controls.name: Submit
controls.description: Checks the choice. Two tries per failure; only the first counts.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: Moves to the next failure. Finish shows the score.

controls.name: Start over
controls.description: Reshuffles and begins a new run.
